text:
Aria Chen: Quickstart update PR draft is up. I consolidated hello-world across Node/Python, switched examples to service tokens, and added a one-command first deploy via `redwood deploy`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012

BuildBot: PR created by Aria Chen  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 (status: draft)

Tom Brooks: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) use REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN in all snippets (avoid REDWOOD_API_KEY), 2) include a curl sample that explicitly shows the Authorization header.

Aria Chen: Yep, changing env var to REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN and adding curl. Draft curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions`

Nina Patel: Can we add a short table in the Quickstart: Use-case -> Credential (Quick try: Service token; Dev w/ login: User API key; Prod: KMS-backed rotated tokens)? Also tiny note about least-privilege scopes.

Aria Chen: Adding that table and a link to the security guide. Also updating private deploy links to /docs/private-deploy/vpc per infra rename.

Tom Brooks: One more: include a short migration callout for SDK v1 -> v2 (replace `streamResponses` with `chat.completions.stream`). Keeps people from confusion.

BuildBot: Checklist added to PR: env var update, curl header, credential table, migration note, private-deploy link update.

Aria Chen: Thanks all 44d I'll push the fixes and mark ready for review once the small CI snippet-smoke action is attached.

Nina Patel: Happy to run a quick prose pass after the code bits land.
